body.p: Applicant respectfully submits that this Amendment does not introduce any new matter. In view of the foregoing amendments and the remarks that follow, Applicant respectfully requests early and favorable reconsideration of the objections and rejections and allowance of this application.
Claims 15-22, 24, and 26 are objected to for informalities.
Without conceding the propriety of the objections set forth in the Office Action, Applicant submits that claims 15-22, 24, and 26 have been amended in a manner believed to overcome the objection.
Therefore, Applicant respectfully requests that the objections of claims 15-22, 24, and 26 be withdrawn.

Claim Re jections under 35 U.S.C. 44 102 and 103

Claims 15-18, 26, and 28 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. @ 102(a)(1) for allegedly being anticipated by European Patent No. 3245947 by Karapantsios et al. ("Karapantsios '947"). Amended independent claim 15, recites, in part:

body.p: (Emphasis Added). Karapantsios '947 fails to teach or suggest the above-noted feature of amended independent claim 15.
Karapantsios '947 relates to an impedance spectroscopy device for early diagnosis of coronary artery disease. (Abstract). However, Karapantsios '947 is silent regarding,

"characterised in that the step of extracting a set of biomarker parameter values comprises the step of determining a biomarker parameter value ma as a ratio between: a gradient of an impedance value of the LPF component waveform measured during a transition of the ischemic cuff from the normal state to the ischemic state, and a gradient of an impedance value of the LPF component waveform measured during a transition of the ischemic cuff from the ischemic state to the hyperaemic state," as recited in amended independent claim 15. (Emphasis added.) Thus, Karapantsios '947 fails to teach or suggest the above-noted features of amended independent claim 15. Therefore, amended independent claim 15 is patentable over Karapantsios '947.
Thrower, Avidor, and/or Romano are not cited as curing and indeed do not cure the deficiencies of Karapantsios '947 with respect to independent claim 15.

Claims 26 and 28 recite similar features as those detailed above with respect to amended independent claim 15. Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 26 and 28 are patentable over the cited art.
Karapantsios '942 is not cited as curing and indeed does not cure the deficiencies of Karapantsios '947 with respect to independent claim 26.

Claims 16-25 depend from amended independent claim 15 and include all features of amended independent claim 1. For at least these reasons, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections of claims 15-28 under 35 U.S.C. § § 102 and 103.
